title: ID0424496-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / P0 312561850/19] Terminal issue ENGIE EME
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
The terminal for this charger hasn't processed any transactions for over 90 days. According to the TMS CCV, the terminal is still sending heartbeats, which makes it unclear whether the issue is with the terminal itself or the CORA10. CORA10 Check: If you find the "error: Terminal candidate list empty " message in the logs, this typically indicates a CORA10 issue, and it should be replaced. If a replacement is required (either for the terminal or the CORA10), please proceed accordingly.
Solution:
NA

Dear Team,
We have investigated the logs and find the charger have “Terminal Candidate list empty” error.
We need to investigate as per following :
Check, if right ports are used to connect COR A10 to OPM-C60.
Check cable connection between Processing Unit and Card Reader.
Re-connect cables and re-start charger.
After troubleshooting, We need to consider Exchanging COR A10.
